entities.summary: Benjamin Joseph McCauley  is an American retired professional basketball player who last played for Brujos de Guayama of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). He played college basketball for North Carolina State University's Wolfpack before playing professionally in France, Belgium, Poland, Ukraine, Spain, Turkey, Puerto Rico and Israel.
